h: Audit report questions N76 billion in cash transfer payments, including N33.75 billion to unverified beneficiaries
p: Auditors have reportedly queried N76.24 billion in transactions at the National Cash Transfer Office, saying payments of N33.75 billion went to beneficiaries who were not identified. The payments span the Buhari and Tinubu administrations.
more: The office has not yet publicly responded to the findings.
